planner-fingerprint.sql:
select true as ok,
       (waiting.n > 0) as blocked,
       'ap=' || coalesce(to_char((select max(p.updated_at) from public.assignment_progress p) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'), 'none')
       || ',rp=' || coalesce(to_char((select max(q.updated_at) from public.reading_progress q) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'), 'none')
       || ',n=' || (select count(*) from public.assignments a)::text
       || ',apn=' || (select count(*) from public.assignment_progress p)::text
       || ',rpn=' || (select count(*) from public.reading_progress q)::text
       || ',at=' || to_char(now() at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as fingerprint,
       waiting.n as requests_open_now, waiting.first_id as first_open_request_id, stale.n as stale_claims,
       r.id as newest_request_id, r.kind as newest_request_kind, r.state as newest_request_state,
       r.created_at as newest_request_created_at, r.claimed_at as newest_request_claimed_at,
       r.finished_at as newest_request_finished_at
  from (select count(*)::integer as n, min(g.id) as first_id
          from public.agent_requests g
         where g.state in ('queued', 'claimed')
           and coalesce(g.claimed_at, g.created_at) >= now() - interval '6 hours') waiting
 cross join (select count(*)::integer as n
               from public.agent_requests g
              where g.state in ('queued', 'claimed')
                and coalesce(g.claimed_at, g.created_at) < now() - interval '6 hours') stale
  left join lateral (select g.id, g.kind, g.state, g.created_at, g.claimed_at, g.finished_at
                       from public.agent_requests g
                      order by g.id desc
                      limit 1) r on true
planner-fingerprint.expect: One row: a reading, with one check. fingerprint holds, as one string, the newest assignment_progress and reading_progress change, the count of assignments, the count of assignment_progress rows (apn), the count of reading_progress rows (rpn) and the time of this read. blocked when an agent_requests row is queued or claimed now (filed or taken within the last 6 hours): a sync or an Inbox apply is waiting or running, so the run stops here, before it has stopped a container or spent a question, and is repeated once that request has ended. A request left queued or claimed for more than 6 hours is not a running sync: it blocks nothing and is counted in stale_claims. The last columns are the newest agent_requests row.

target-before.sql:
with target as (
  select p.assignment_id
    from public.assignment_progress p
   where p.status = 'graded' and p.notes is null
   order by p.assignment_id
   limit 1
)
select (t.assignment_id is not null and p.assignment_id is not null) as ok,
       md5(t.assignment_id) as target_md5,
       md5((to_jsonb(p) - 'updated_at')::text) as row_md5,
       md5((to_jsonb(p) - 'updated_at' - 'notes')::text) as rest_md5,
       p.status as target_status,
       p.updated_at as target_updated_at,
       (select count(*) from public.assignment_progress c where c.status = 'graded' and c.notes is null)::integer as candidates,
       'ap=' || coalesce(to_char((select max(p.updated_at) from public.assignment_progress p where md5(p.assignment_id) is distinct from md5(t.assignment_id)) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'), 'none')
       || ',rp=' || coalesce(to_char((select max(q.updated_at) from public.reading_progress q) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'), 'none')
       || ',n=' || (select count(*) from public.assignments a)::text
       || ',apn=' || (select count(*) from public.assignment_progress p)::text
       || ',rpn=' || (select count(*) from public.reading_progress q)::text
       || ',at=' || to_char(now() at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as fingerprint
  from (select 1 as one) one
  left join target t on true
  left join public.assignment_progress p on p.assignment_id = t.assignment_id
target-before.expect: One row: a reading, saved as target_before. The run proposes on one field of one row: the notes of the first assignment, by id, whose assignment_progress row is graded and holds no note (the browser test of step 3 picks it by the same rule). ok when such a row exists; candidates counts them. target_md5 is the md5 of its assignment id, so no id or text leaves the database; row_md5 is the md5 of the whole row but updated_at, rest_md5 the same without notes. fingerprint is planner-fingerprint's string with that one row left out of the newest assignment_progress change (the counts keep it), so planner-restored can hold the rest of the planner to it after the run has written that row and cleared it again.

runners-alive.sql:
select (s.runners_alive = 2
        and s.alive_runners = array['workspace@bb2dash-workspace', 'workspace@bb2dash-workspace-2']::text[]) as ok,
       s.runners_alive,
       (s.alive_runners = array['workspace@bb2dash-workspace', 'workspace@bb2dash-workspace-2']::text[]) as both_names,
       s.polled_age_seconds
  from (select 1 as one) one
  left join public.v_workspace_status s on true
runners-alive.expect: One row. ok when v_workspace_status (migration 202) counts two runners whose heartbeat is under 90 seconds old and names exactly workspace@bb2dash-workspace and workspace@bb2dash-workspace-2, sorted: both Workspace services are up and reach the database, which is what each container's healthcheck reads. both_names says whether the names are those two; the names themselves hold an @ and show as withheld.

two-at-once.sql:
with pair as (
  select r.id, r.state, r.error_code, r.conversation_id, r.created_at, r.claimed_at, r.claimed_by, r.finished_at,
         md5(u.content) as asked_md5, m.finished as answer_finished, m.error_code as answer_error_code
    from public.workspace_requests r
    left join public.workspace_messages u on u.id = r.user_message_id and u.role = 'user'
    left join public.workspace_messages m on m.request_id = r.id and m.role = 'assistant'
   where r.id in ($1::bigint, $2::bigint)
)
select (a.id is not null and b.id is not null
        and a.state = 'done' and b.state = 'done' and a.error_code is null and b.error_code is null
        and coalesce(a.answer_finished, false) and coalesce(b.answer_finished, false)
        and a.answer_error_code is null and b.answer_error_code is null
        and a.created_at >= $3::timestamptz - interval '60 seconds' and b.created_at >= $3::timestamptz - interval '60 seconds'
        and a.asked_md5 = $4::text and b.asked_md5 = $5::text
        and a.conversation_id <> b.conversation_id
        and a.claimed_by in ('workspace@bb2dash-workspace', 'workspace@bb2dash-workspace-2')
        and b.claimed_by in ('workspace@bb2dash-workspace', 'workspace@bb2dash-workspace-2')
        and a.claimed_by <> b.claimed_by
        and a.claimed_at < b.finished_at and b.claimed_at < a.finished_at) as ok,
       a.id as first_request_id, a.state as first_state, a.created_at as first_created_at,
       a.claimed_at as first_claimed_at, a.finished_at as first_finished_at,
       b.id as second_request_id, b.state as second_state, b.created_at as second_created_at,
       b.claimed_at as second_claimed_at, b.finished_at as second_finished_at,
       (a.asked_md5 = $4::text and b.asked_md5 = $5::text) as questions_match,
       (a.conversation_id <> b.conversation_id) as two_conversations,
       (a.claimed_by <> b.claimed_by) as two_runners,
       (a.claimed_at < b.finished_at and b.claimed_at < a.finished_at) as claims_overlap,
       round(extract(epoch from (least(a.finished_at, b.finished_at) - greatest(a.claimed_at, b.claimed_at)))::numeric, 3) as overlap_s,
       round(abs(extract(epoch from (a.created_at - b.created_at)))::numeric, 3) as asked_apart_s
  from (select 1 as one) one
  left join pair a on a.id = $1::bigint
  left join pair b on b.id = $2::bigint
two-at-once.expect: One row. ok when both requests are this run's (created no earlier than 60 seconds before the run started), each holds the question its half of step 2 types (the md5 of the user message is the md5 given), both are done with no error code and a finished answer, they are in two conversations, two different runners took them (claimed_by is workspace@bb2dash-workspace for one and workspace@bb2dash-workspace-2 for the other), and their claim windows overlap: each was claimed before the other finished. overlap_s is how many seconds both were being answered at once; asked_apart_s how far apart the two were asked. Ids, states, flags and times only.

proposal-made.sql:
select (w.id is not null and r.id is not null and u.id is not null and i.id is not null
        and w.request_id = $2::bigint
        and w.created_at >= $3::timestamptz - interval '60 seconds'
        and r.created_at >= $3::timestamptz - interval '60 seconds'
        and r.state = 'done' and r.error_code is null
        and w.conversation_id = r.conversation_id
        and md5(u.content) = md5('Propose one planner change with your planner tool for the assignment ' || w.row_id || ': set its notes to "Acceptance run 25 proposal ' || $5::text || '". Change nothing else.')
        and md5(w.row_id) = $4::text
        and w.target = 'assignment_progress' and w.field = 'notes'
        and jsonb_typeof(w.new_value) = 'string'
        and ($5::text <> 'one' or coalesce(jsonb_typeof(w.old_value), 'null') = 'null')
        and k.made = 1
        and i.kind = 'assistant_proposal' and i.entity = 'assignment_progress'
        and i.ref = 'workspace_proposal/' || w.id::text) as ok,
       w.id as proposal_id, w.request_id, w.conversation_id, w.created_at as proposal_created_at, w.expires_at,
       w.target as proposal_target, w.field as proposal_field, w.state as proposal_state,
       (md5(w.row_id) = $4::text) as target_matches,
       (md5(u.content) = md5('Propose one planner change with your planner tool for the assignment ' || w.row_id || ': set its notes to "Acceptance run 25 proposal ' || $5::text || '". Change nothing else.')) as question_matches,
       jsonb_typeof(w.old_value) as old_value_type, jsonb_typeof(w.new_value) as new_value_type,
       r.state as request_state, r.error_code as request_error_code, r.created_at as request_created_at,
       k.made as proposals_of_request,
       i.id as item_id, i.kind as item_kind, i.state as item_state
  from (select $1::bigint as id) want
  left join public.workspace_proposals w on w.id = want.id
  left join public.workspace_requests r on r.id = w.request_id
  left join public.workspace_messages u on u.id = r.user_message_id and u.role = 'user'
  left join public.attention_items i on i.workspace_proposal_id = w.id
  left join lateral (select count(*)::integer as made
                       from public.workspace_proposals x
                      where x.request_id = w.request_id) k on true
proposal-made.expect: One row. ok when the proposal is this run's (it and its request were created no earlier than 60 seconds before the run started), it belongs to the request the step's card stood under, that request is done with no error code and is in the proposal's conversation, the question is the step's (the md5 of the user message is the md5 of the proposal question rebuilt from the proposal's own row id and the step's word: one, two or three), the row is the run's (the md5 of row_id is target_before's), it proposes a new note for an assignment (target assignment_progress, field notes, new_value a JSON string), the first proposal read no note (old_value JSON null or absent), the request made exactly this one proposal, and its Inbox item is there: kind assistant_proposal, entity assignment_progress, ref workspace_proposal/<id>. No value, reason, label or question is read out: types, ids, states and flags only.

proposal-applied.sql:
select (w.id is not null and p.assignment_id is not null and i.id is not null
        and w.state = 'applied' and w.decided_at is not null
        and w.decided_at >= $2::timestamptz - interval '60 seconds'
        and md5(w.row_id) = $3::text
        and to_jsonb(p.notes) = w.new_value
        and p.updated_at >= w.created_at
        and p.updated_at <= w.decided_at + interval '1 second'
        and md5((to_jsonb(p) - 'updated_at' - 'notes')::text) = $4::text
        and i.state = 'resolved' and i.resolved_at is not null
        and i.resolution ->> 'outcome' = 'applied'
        and i.resolution ->> 'proposal_id' = w.id::text) as ok,
       w.id as proposal_id, w.state as proposal_state, w.created_at as proposal_created_at, w.decided_at,
       p.updated_at as row_updated_at,
       (to_jsonb(p.notes) = w.new_value) as row_holds_proposed_value,
       (md5((to_jsonb(p) - 'updated_at' - 'notes')::text) = $4::text) as rest_of_row_unchanged,
       i.id as item_id, i.state as item_state, i.resolution ->> 'outcome' as item_outcome, i.resolved_at as item_resolved_at
  from (select $1::bigint as id) want
  left join public.workspace_proposals w on w.id = want.id
  left join public.assignment_progress p on p.assignment_id = w.row_id and w.target = 'assignment_progress'
  left join public.attention_items i on i.workspace_proposal_id = w.id
proposal-applied.expect: One row. ok when the proposal reads applied with decided_at set in this run, it is on the run's row (target_before's md5), the row now holds the proposed note (to_jsonb of notes equals new_value), the row was written once and by the decision: its updated_at is after the proposal was made and no later than one second after decided_at, so nothing wrote it after the approval; every other column of the row reads as at go-live (rest_md5); and the Inbox item reads the same outcome: resolved, with resolution outcome applied and the proposal's id. No value is read out.

proposal-rejected.sql:
select (b.id is not null and a.id is not null and p.assignment_id is not null and i.id is not null
        and b.state = 'rejected' and b.decided_at is not null
        and b.decided_at >= $3::timestamptz - interval '60 seconds'
        and b.created_at > a.created_at and b.decided_at > a.decided_at
        and b.conversation_id = a.conversation_id and b.target = a.target and b.row_id = a.row_id and b.field = a.field
        and a.state = 'applied'
        and to_jsonb(p.notes) = a.new_value
        and p.updated_at <= a.decided_at + interval '1 second'
        and i.state = 'resolved' and i.resolved_at is not null
        and i.resolution ->> 'outcome' = 'rejected'
        and i.resolution ->> 'proposal_id' = b.id::text) as ok,
       b.id as proposal_id, b.state as proposal_state, b.created_at as proposal_created_at, b.decided_at,
       a.id as first_proposal_id, a.state as first_state, a.decided_at as first_decided_at,
       (b.row_id = a.row_id and b.field = a.field) as same_field,
       (to_jsonb(p.notes) = a.new_value) as row_holds_first_value,
       p.updated_at as row_updated_at,
       i.id as item_id, i.state as item_state, i.resolution ->> 'outcome' as item_outcome
  from (select $1::bigint as id) want
  left join public.workspace_proposals b on b.id = want.id
  left join public.workspace_proposals a on a.id = $2::bigint
  left join public.assignment_progress p on p.assignment_id = a.row_id and a.target = 'assignment_progress'
  left join public.attention_items i on i.workspace_proposal_id = b.id
proposal-rejected.expect: One row. ok when the second proposal reads rejected with decided_at set in this run and after the first was decided, it is in the first proposal's conversation on the same row and field, its Inbox item is resolved with resolution outcome rejected and its id (the decision was made there), and the rejection wrote nothing: the row still holds the first proposal's note and its updated_at is no later than one second after the first proposal's decision. No value is read out.

decisions-held.sql:
select (a.id is not null and b.id is not null and p.assignment_id is not null
        and a.state = 'applied' and b.state = 'rejected'
        and a.decided_at >= $3::timestamptz - interval '60 seconds' and b.decided_at > a.decided_at
        and ia.n = 1 and ib.n = 1
        and ia.outcome = 'applied' and ib.outcome = 'rejected'
        and ia.resolved = 1 and ib.resolved = 1
        and to_jsonb(p.notes) = a.new_value
        and p.updated_at <= a.decided_at + interval '1 second') as ok,
       a.id as first_proposal_id, a.state as first_state, a.decided_at as first_decided_at,
       b.id as second_proposal_id, b.state as second_state, b.decided_at as second_decided_at,
       ia.n as first_items, ia.outcome as first_item_outcome, ib.n as second_items, ib.outcome as second_item_outcome,
       (to_jsonb(p.notes) = a.new_value) as row_holds_first_value, p.updated_at as row_updated_at
  from (select 1 as one) one
  left join public.workspace_proposals a on a.id = $1::bigint
  left join public.workspace_proposals b on b.id = $2::bigint
  left join public.assignment_progress p on p.assignment_id = a.row_id and a.target = 'assignment_progress'
  left join lateral (select count(*)::integer as n, min(i.resolution ->> 'outcome') as outcome,
                            (count(*) filter (where i.state = 'resolved'))::integer as resolved
                       from public.attention_items i where i.workspace_proposal_id = a.id) ia on true
  left join lateral (select count(*)::integer as n, min(i.resolution ->> 'outcome') as outcome,
                            (count(*) filter (where i.state = 'resolved'))::integer as resolved
                       from public.attention_items i where i.workspace_proposal_id = b.id) ib on true
decisions-held.expect: One row, read after the refused second decisions of step 6. ok when the first proposal still reads applied and the second still reads rejected, each with its one Inbox item resolved with that outcome, and the row was not written again: it holds the first proposal's note and its updated_at is no later than one second after the first decision. A second decision that had gone through would show as another state, another outcome or a later write. No value is read out.

proposal-stale.sql:
select (c.id is not null and a.id is not null and p.assignment_id is not null and i.id is not null
        and c.state = 'stale' and c.decided_at is not null
        and c.decided_at >= $3::timestamptz - interval '60 seconds'
        and c.conversation_id = a.conversation_id and c.target = a.target and c.row_id = a.row_id and c.field = a.field
        and c.created_at > a.decided_at
        and c.old_value = a.new_value
        and p.notes is not null
        and to_jsonb(p.notes) <> c.new_value and to_jsonb(p.notes) <> a.new_value
        and p.updated_at > c.created_at and p.updated_at < c.decided_at
        and i.state = 'resolved' and i.resolved_at is not null
        and i.resolution ->> 'outcome' = 'stale'
        and i.resolution ->> 'proposal_id' = c.id::text) as ok,
       c.id as proposal_id, c.state as proposal_state, c.created_at as proposal_created_at, c.decided_at,
       a.id as first_proposal_id,
       (c.old_value = a.new_value) as read_the_first_value,
       (to_jsonb(p.notes) <> c.new_value and to_jsonb(p.notes) <> a.new_value) as row_holds_another_value,
       p.updated_at as row_updated_at,
       (p.updated_at > c.created_at and p.updated_at < c.decided_at) as edited_between,
       i.id as item_id, i.state as item_state, i.resolution ->> 'outcome' as item_outcome
  from (select $1::bigint as id) want
  left join public.workspace_proposals c on c.id = want.id
  left join public.workspace_proposals a on a.id = $2::bigint
  left join public.assignment_progress p on p.assignment_id = a.row_id and a.target = 'assignment_progress'
  left join public.attention_items i on i.workspace_proposal_id = c.id
proposal-stale.expect: One row. ok when the third proposal reads stale with decided_at set in this run, it is on the first proposal's row and field in the same conversation, made after the first was approved and reading the first proposal's note as the value it would replace, the row was written between the proposal and its decision (the planner edit: updated_at after the proposal was made and before decided_at) and holds a note that is neither proposal's, so the approval found the row changed and wrote nothing after; and its Inbox item is resolved with resolution outcome stale. No value is read out.

conversations-unarchived.sql:
select (count(*) >= $2::integer and count(*) filter (where not c.archived) = 0) as ok,
       count(*)::integer as made_in_this_run,
       $2::integer as at_least,
       (count(*) filter (where not c.archived))::integer as listed,
       coalesce(array_agg(c.id) filter (where not c.archived), '{}') as not_archived
  from public.workspace_conversations c
 where c.created_at >= $1::timestamptz - interval '60 seconds'
conversations-unarchived.expect: One row. ok when at least min_conversations conversations were made in this run (created no earlier than 60 seconds before the run started) and none of them is still listed: each step archived the conversation it opened, through the page, and the pack leaves nothing in his list or his memory. not_archived lists the ids still listed.

planner-restored.sql:
with given as (
  select substring($1::text from '^(.*),at=') as planner,
         substring($1::text from ',at=(.*)$')::timestamptz as since
), seen as (
  select 'ap=' || coalesce(to_char((select max(p.updated_at) from public.assignment_progress p where md5(p.assignment_id) is distinct from $2::text) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'), 'none')
       || ',rp=' || coalesce(to_char((select max(q.updated_at) from public.reading_progress q) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'), 'none')
       || ',n=' || (select count(*) from public.assignments a)::text
       || ',apn=' || (select count(*) from public.assignment_progress p)::text
       || ',rpn=' || (select count(*) from public.reading_progress q)::text as planner
), target as (
  select count(*)::integer as n,
         min(md5((to_jsonb(p) - 'updated_at')::text)) as row_now,
         max(p.updated_at) as row_updated_at
    from public.assignment_progress p
   where md5(p.assignment_id) = $2::text
), moved as (
  select count(*)::integer as n, min(g.id) as first_id, max(g.id) as last_id
    from public.agent_requests g, given
   where g.created_at >= given.since or g.claimed_at >= given.since or g.finished_at >= given.since
), running as (
  select count(*)::integer as n, min(g.id) as first_id
    from public.agent_requests g
   where g.state = 'claimed' and g.claimed_at >= now() - interval '6 hours'
), stale as (
  select count(*)::integer as n
    from public.agent_requests g
   where g.state = 'claimed' and g.claimed_at < now() - interval '6 hours'
)
select (seen.planner = given.planner and target.n = 1 and target.row_now = $3::text) as ok,
       (not (seen.planner = given.planner and target.n = 1 and target.row_now = $3::text)
        and (moved.n > 0 or running.n > 0)) as blocked,
       (target.n = 1 and target.row_now = $3::text) as row_restored,
       (seen.planner = given.planner) as rest_of_planner_unchanged,
       target.row_updated_at,
       $1::text as planner_before,
       seen.planner || ',at=' || to_char(now() at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as planner_now,
       given.since as since, now() as read_at,
       moved.n as requests_in_window, moved.first_id as first_request_id, moved.last_id as last_request_id,
       running.n as requests_claimed_now, running.first_id as first_claimed_request_id, stale.n as stale_claims
  from given, seen, target, moved, running, stale
planner-restored.expect: One row. ok when the run's row reads as it did at go-live in every column but updated_at (its md5 is target_before's row_md5: the note is gone again and nothing else of the row moved) and the rest of the planner reads as at go-live: the newest assignment_progress change with that row left out, the newest reading_progress change, the count of assignments and the row counts of the two progress tables are the five values of target_before's fingerprint. blocked only when one of these differs AND a sync or an Inbox apply could be why (an agent_requests row was created, claimed or finished at or after go-live, or one is claimed now within 6 hours), as planner-unchanged decides in pack 24. A claim older than 6 hours is counted in stale_claims and turns nothing into a repeat.

proposals-not-queued.sql:
with ours as (
  select w.id, w.state, i.id as item_id, i.kind as item_kind, i.state as item_state
    from public.workspace_proposals w
    left join public.attention_items i on i.workspace_proposal_id = w.id
   where w.id in ($1::bigint, $2::bigint, $3::bigint)
     and w.created_at >= $4::timestamptz - interval '60 seconds'
), queued as (
  select count(*)::integer as n,
         (count(*) filter (where q.id in (select o.item_id from ours o)))::integer as ours_n
    from public.v_inbox_queue q
